case_analysis.apparent_benchmark_claim: The case appears to claim success when the agent answers the Spotify question correctly and the two registered requirements pass, including the literal requirement text `assert no model changes.`
case_analysis.actual_checked_outcome: The released AppWorld path loads `cef9191_3` from `specs.json`, loads that task's ground truth, pairs the task-input start state with the retained experiment end state, runs `ground_truth/evaluation.py`, and marks success only when the two registered `with test(...)` blocks pass: answer equality against `ground_truth_answer` and `models.changed_model_names()` being falsy.
case_analysis.target_construction_review: The answer target is the frozen ground-truth answer `Zoey James`. The second target is not literal database immutability; it is the helper-defined `changed_model_names()` result over the start/end model collections, with default exclusions including `supervisor.Task`, `admin.PaymentCard`, and `amazon.BrowsedProduct`.
case_analysis.evaluator_oracle_review: `test.task_completed` is only a dynamic attribute assignment and does not register a test. The second registered requirement is operationalized through `models.changed_model_names()`, so the evaluator uses a weaker same-outcome proxy than the literal text `assert no model changes.`
case_analysis.reward_wiring_aggregation_review: There is no separate reward predicate. `run_official_job` serializes the official `TestTracker`, the released record label comes from `native_evaluator_output.json::tracker.success`, and `Metric` only reports aggregates without changing any individual `TestTracker.success`.

official_benchmark_assessment.description: The requirement text `assert no model changes.` overstates what the released evaluator actually checks. The oracle delegates to `models.changed_model_names()`, which ignores `supervisor.Task` and some other model names by default, so the released measurement is a weaker operationalization of the same intended no-op outcome rather than a different outcome check.

checklist_and_case_packet_assessment.description: The frozen checklist and case packet preserve the official two-test conjunction, explicitly exclude `test.task_completed` from native scoring, keep released evaluator outputs out of scorer-visible evidence, and leave stronger conditions empty.

records.reason: The retained record shows the official evaluator checked answer equality plus helper-filtered `changed_model_names()` falsiness and returned `tracker.success=true`. The only recorded changed model hash is the helper-ignored `supervisor.Task`, so this is a weaker same-outcome operationalization of `assert no model changes.`, not a confirmed different-outcome conflict.

semantic_comparison.target_construction: This record's end state stores `"Zoey James"` in `supervisor.Task.answer`; `model_hashes.json` records only `supervisor.Task` as changed, and the Spotify DB snapshot matches the official start snapshot line-for-line.
semantic_comparison.aggregation: `run_official_job` serialized the tracker from `evaluate_task`, `run_summary.json` recorded `success=true`, and the released label stayed the direct mapping of `native_evaluator_output.json::tracker.success` with no separate reward override.
